headline: Palantine Berm Ignites into Fierce Clashes as Northern Fronts Shift
war_summary: Since our previous edition, fighting has pivoted sharply across several sectors, with Palantine Berm abruptly catching fire as seven base exchanges erupted across the past two hours, churning the sector into a split front around Pippeli Stones and The Droll. Further east, the lull at Marban Hollow proved short-lived; contest over Checkpoint Bua reignited with five fresh line shifts and mounting casualties. By contrast, the sudden storm that rocked Kuura Strand has completely settled into silence, logging not a single casualty over the two-hour wire, while Mooring County has likewise cooled from its prior fury. The bloodiest meatgrinders continue unabated, however. In the Weathered Expanse, relentless skirmishing near Wightwalk and Frostmarch yielded five more base transitions and over twenty-five hundred dead, leaving two strongpoints in neutral ruins. Meanwhile, Linn of Mercy and the Nevish Line endured staggering slaughter—each hex swallowing thousands of fallen soldiers in two hours—as Colonial and Warden lines grind against each other under relentless pressure.
